channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-webaudio
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: seance — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Sample workbench on the Web Audio API: spectrogram, drum stem separation, hit-based slicing and BS.1770-4 loudness, all in the browser.

item.title: psoup noise machine — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Free generative noise machine in the browser: brown, pink and white noise computed live with the Web Audio API, tuned by the moon and the day's earthquakes.

item.title: eko-web — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Web Audio playback engine for music players with gapless playback, crossfade, loudness normalization and React and Vue bindings.

item.title: Tonecrafted Progressions — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Free browser chord-progression player and ear-training tool for guitarists, no signup.

item.title: Soundworks — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Open-source creative coding framework for distributed applications based on Web technologies.

item.title: Ocarina Simulator — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: A playable 3D ocarina with sampled and synthesized voices, breath-controlled dynamics from the microphone and song recognition. Live demo.

item.title: Music Theory for Programmers — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Music theory derived from scratch in JavaScript, with runnable Web Audio examples.

item.title: Melody Mate — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: In-browser generative MIDI workstation and melodic sketchpad using rule-based music theory heuristics and Web Audio API.

item.title: Klaviero — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Falling-notes piano game for MIDI keyboards, built on Web MIDI and Web Audio (Tone.js), with in-browser audio to MIDI.

item.title: Key Kalimba — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Github - Interactive 17-key Kalimba trainer, falling notes visualizer, and real-time tuner with pitch detection.

item.title: Database Inside a Song — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Splits a stereo WAV, reconstructs its side channel, and visualizes the 18 kHz and 20 kHz carriers holding a byte-exact SQLite database.

item.title: Bardkit — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: A sample-free plucked-string instrument for multiplayer games, with a four-voice pool and per-listener distance gain.

item.title: Audio Browser Lab — via awesome-webaudio
item.description: Reproduce and diagnose browser audio playback, seeking, codec, and lifecycle bugs with shareable evidence.
